```python
import enum
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from typing import Annotated, List, Optional

import jwt
from fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, HTTPException, Query, status
from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordBearer, OAuth2PasswordRequestForm
from passlib.context import CryptContext
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field
from sqlalchemy import Column, DateTime, Enum, ForeignKey, Integer, String, Text, create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, Session, relationship, sessionmaker

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Configuration & Security
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
SECRET_KEY = "CHANGE_THIS_TO_A_SECURE_RANDOM_SECRET_KEY"
ALGORITHM = "HS256"
ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES = 60

pwd_context = CryptContext(schemes=["bcrypt"], deprecated="auto")
oauth2_scheme = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl="/auth/token")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Database Setup
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
DATABASE_URL = "sqlite:///./tickets.db"
engine = create_engine(DATABASE_URL, connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
SessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)


class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass


class TicketPriority(str, enum.Enum):
    LOW = "low"
    MEDIUM = "medium"
    HIGH = "high"
    URGENT = "urgent"


class TicketStatus(str, enum.Enum):
    OPEN = "open"
    IN_PROGRESS = "in_progress"
    RESOLVED = "resolved"
    CLOSED = "closed"


class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    username = Column(String(50), unique=True, index=True, nullable=False)
    hashed_password = Column(String(255), nullable=False)

    tickets = relationship("Ticket", back_populates="owner", cascade="all, delete-orphan")


class Ticket(Base):
    __tablename__ = "tickets"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    title = Column(String(150), nullable=False)
    body = Column(Text, nullable=False)
    priority = Column(Enum(TicketPriority), default=TicketPriority.MEDIUM, nullable=False)
    status = Column(Enum(TicketStatus), default=TicketStatus.OPEN, nullable=False)
    created_at = Column(DateTime(timezone=True), default=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc))
    owner_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("users.id"), nullable=False)

    owner = relationship("User", back_populates="tickets")


Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)


def get_db():
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Pydantic Schemas
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
class UserCreate(BaseModel):
    username: str = Field(..., min_length=3, max_length=50)
    password: str = Field(..., min_length=6)


class UserResponse(BaseModel):
    id: int
    username: str

    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)


class Token(BaseModel):
    access_token: str
    token_type: str


class TicketCreate(BaseModel):
    title: str = Field(..., min_length=3, max_length=150)
    body: str = Field(..., min_length=10)
    priority: TicketPriority = TicketPriority.MEDIUM


class TicketResponse(BaseModel):
    id: int
    title: str
    body: str
    priority: TicketPriority
    status: TicketStatus
    created_at: datetime
    owner_id: int

    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Auth Utilities & Dependencies
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
def verify_password(plain_password: str, hashed_password: str) -> bool:
    return pwd_context.verify(plain_password, hashed_password)


def get_password_hash(password: str) -> str:
    return pwd_context.hash(password)


def create_access_token(data: dict, expires_delta: Optional[timedelta] = None) -> str:
    to_encode = data.copy()
    expire = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + (
        expires_delta if expires_delta else timedelta(minutes=ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES)
    )
    to_encode.update({"exp": expire})
    return jwt.encode(to_encode, SECRET_KEY, algorithm=ALGORITHM)


def get_current_user(
    token: Annotated[str, Depends(oauth2_scheme)],
    db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)],
) -> User:
    credentials_exception = HTTPException(
        status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
        detail="Could not validate credentials",
        headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},
    )
    try:
        payload = jwt.decode(token, SECRET_KEY, algorithms=[ALGORITHM])
        username: str = payload.get("sub")
        if username is None:
            raise credentials_exception
    except jwt.PyJWTError:
        raise credentials_exception

    user = db.query(User).filter(User.username == username).first()
    if user is None:
        raise credentials_exception
    return user


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# FastAPI App & Endpoints
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
app = FastAPI(title="Support Ticket API", version="1.0.0")


@app.post("/auth/register", response_model=UserResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def register(user_in: UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    """Register a new user."""
    existing_user = db.query(User).filter(User.username == user_in.username).first()
    if existing_user:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            detail="Username already registered",
        )
    user = User(
        username=user_in.username,
        hashed_password=get_password_hash(user_in.password),
    )
    db.add(user)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(user)
    return user


@app.post("/auth/token", response_model=Token)
def login(
    form_data: Annotated[OAuth2PasswordRequestForm, Depends()],
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    """Obtain a Bearer JWT access token using form login credentials."""
    user = db.query(User).filter(User.username == form_data.username).first()
    if not user or not verify_password(form_data.password, user.hashed_password):
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Incorrect username or password",
            headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},
        )

    access_token = create_access_token(data={"sub": user.username})
    return {"access_token": access_token, "token_type": "bearer"}


@app.post("/tickets", response_model=TicketResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def create_ticket(
    ticket_in: TicketCreate,
    current_user: Annotated[User, Depends(get_current_user)],
    db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)],
):
    """Create a new support ticket assigned to the authenticated user."""
    ticket = Ticket(
        title=ticket_in.title,
        body=ticket_in.body,
        priority=ticket_in.priority,
        owner_id=current_user.id,
    )
    db.add(ticket)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(ticket)
    return ticket


@app.get("/tickets", response_model=List[TicketResponse])
def list_my_tickets(
    current_user: Annotated[User, Depends(get_current_user)],
    db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)],
    skip: int = Query(0, ge=0, description="Pagination offset"),
    limit: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100, description="Pagination limit"),
):
    """List all tickets belonging strictly to the currently authenticated user."""
    tickets = (
        db.query(Ticket)
        .filter(Ticket.owner_id == current_user.id)
        .order_by(Ticket.created_at.desc())
        .offset(skip)
        .limit(limit)
        .all()
    )
    return tickets
```

```bash

```

Visit the interactive Swagger UI at **`http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs`**:

1. Call `POST /auth/register` with `{"username": "alice", "password": "secretpassword"}`.
2. Click the **Authorize** button in Swagger (or call `POST /auth/token`) to log in with `alice`.
3. Call `POST /tickets` with:

   ```json
     "title": "Cannot access dashboard",
     "body": "Getting a 500 internal server error upon login.",
     "priority": "urgent"
   }
   ```
4. Call `GET /tickets` to see the list of tickets for `alice`.

### Rigour Level & Plan

**Stakes & Rigour Level**: Production-grade (untrusted network-reachable endpoint handling authenticated writes). Universal non-negotiables (abuse control, transport enforcement, tests, structured logging without PII/secrets) apply in full.

#### Concrete Requirements
1. **Schema & Input Validation**:
   - `TicketCreate`: `title` (1–100 chars, NFC-normalized, no control characters/NUL), `body` (1–5000 chars, no NUL), `priority` (`low`, `medium`, `high`, `urgent`).
   - Strict `extra="forbid"` on all input DTOs (mass assignment defense).
   - Strict payload size limit enforcement at middleware layer (max 64 KiB) responding `413 Payload Too Large`.
2. **Authentication & Authorization**:
   - Bearer JWT authentication (validating `exp`, `iss`, `aud`, and signature).
   - Default-deny architecture.
   - Object-level authorization (BOLA/IDOR protection): tickets are written with `owner_id = current_user.id` and listed strictly via `WHERE owner_id = ?`.
3. **Abuse Control & Rate Limiting**:
   - Sliding-window counter keyed by authenticated `user_id` (IP fallback for unauthenticated requests).
   - Emits standard IETF headers (`RateLimit`, `RateLimit-Policy`, and on breach `Retry-After`).
   - Exceeded quota returns `429 Too Many Requests` with `application/problem+json`.
4. **Transport Enforcement & Defensive Headers**:
   - TLS/HTTPS enforcement middleware: blocks cleartext requests without transparent redirects on API routes (returns `400 Bad Request`).
   - Injects `Strict-Transport-Security`, `Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'`, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`, and `Cache-Control: no-store`.
5. **Structured Logging & Observability**:
   - Emits single-line JSON logs.
   - Request-scoped correlation ID (`trace_id` / `X-Request-ID`).
   - Logger-level redaction filter scrubbing authorization headers, tokens, and secrets.
   - Canonical "wide event" emitted on request completion (including exceptions).
   - Append-only security audit log for high-value actions (ticket creation, rate-limit trips, auth failures).
6. **Error Handling**:
   - Global exception boundary returning generic RFC 9457 Problem Details with correlation ID; no stack traces, paths, or database internals exposed to clients.
7. **Test Suite**:
   - Comprehensive test suite covering auth, validation, BOLA isolation, rate limiting, transport enforcement, headers, and error masking.

```python
"""
Support Ticket API
Production-grade FastAPI implementation with transport enforcement, BOLA defense,
sliding-window rate limiting, structured JSON logging, and security hardening.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import enum
import json
import logging
import re
import sqlite3
import sys
import time
import unicodedata
import uuid
from contextvars import ContextVar
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple

import jwt
from fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, HTTPException, Request, Response, status
from fastapi.exceptions import RequestValidationError
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, field_validator

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Configuration & Security Constants
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
JWT_SECRET = "production-must-load-this-from-kms-or-env-secret-min32bytes"
JWT_ALGORITHM = "HS256"
JWT_ISSUER = "support-ticket-api"
JWT_AUDIENCE = "support-ticket-client"

MAX_REQUEST_BYTES = 64 * 1024  # 64 KiB body cap
RATE_LIMIT_MAX_REQUESTS = 60
RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_SECONDS = 60

# Context variable for correlation/trace ID
trace_id_ctx: ContextVar[str] = ContextVar("trace_id", default="")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Structured Logging with Redaction & Wide Events
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
SENSITIVE_KEY_PATTERN = re.compile(
    r"(?i)(password|secret|token|authorization|cookie|bearer|api[_-]?key)"
)
JWT_PATTERN = re.compile(r"eyJ[A-Za-z0-9-_=]+\.[A-Za-z0-9-_=]+\.?[A-Za-z0-9-_.+/=]*")


class SecurityScrubbingFilter(logging.Filter):
    """Enforces central redaction of credentials, bearer tokens, and secrets."""

    def filter(self, record: logging.LogRecord) -> bool:
        if isinstance(record.msg, str):
            record.msg = JWT_PATTERN.sub("[REDACTED_JWT]", record.msg)
            record.msg = record.msg.replace("\r", "\\r").replace("\n", "\\n")
        if isinstance(record.args, dict):
            record.args = {
                k: "[REDACTED]" if SENSITIVE_KEY_PATTERN.search(str(k)) else v
                for k, v in record.args.items()
            }
        return True


class JsonFormatter(logging.Formatter):
    """Formats log records as single-line JSON with UTC ISO-8601 timestamps."""

    def format(self, record: logging.LogRecord) -> str:
        log_obj: Dict[str, Any] = {
            "timestamp": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            "level": record.levelname,
            "logger": record.name,
            "message": record.getMessage(),
            "trace_id": trace_id_ctx.get(),
        }
        if hasattr(record, "extra_fields") and isinstance(record.extra_fields, dict):
            log_obj.update(record.extra_fields)
        if record.exc_info:
            log_obj["exception"] = self.formatException(record.exc_info)
        return json.dumps(log_obj)


handler = logging.StreamHandler(sys.stdout)
handler.addFilter(SecurityScrubbingFilter())
handler.setFormatter(JsonFormatter())

logger = logging.getLogger("tickets")
logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)
logger.handlers = [handler]
logger.propagate = False

audit_logger = logging.getLogger("security.audit")
audit_logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)
audit_logger.handlers = [handler]
audit_logger.propagate = False


def emit_audit_event(event_type: str, actor_id: str, outcome: str, details: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    """Emits an immutable, structured security audit record."""
    record = logging.LogRecord(
        name="security.audit",
        level=logging.INFO,
        pathname=__file__,
        lineno=0,
        msg=f"audit_event:{event_type}",
        args=(),
        exc_info=None,
    )
    record.extra_fields = {
        "event_type": event_type,
        "actor_id": actor_id,
        "outcome": outcome,
        "details": details,
        "audit": True,
    }
    audit_logger.handle(record)


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Database Layer (Thread-Safe Parameterized SQLite)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
DB_FILE = ":memory:"


def init_db(connection: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
    with connection:
        connection.execute(
            """
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tickets (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                owner_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                title TEXT NOT NULL,
                body TEXT NOT NULL,
                priority TEXT NOT NULL,
                status TEXT NOT NULL,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
            );
            """
        )
        connection.execute(
            "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tickets_owner ON tickets (owner_id);"
        )


db_conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_FILE, check_same_thread=False)
db_conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
init_db(db_conn)


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Domain Models & Strict Allowlist Schemas
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
class TicketPriority(str, enum.Enum):
    LOW = "low"
    MEDIUM = "medium"
    HIGH = "high"
    URGENT = "urgent"


class TicketStatus(str, enum.Enum):
    OPEN = "open"
    IN_PROGRESS = "in_progress"
    RESOLVED = "resolved"
    CLOSED = "closed"


def sanitize_text(value: str) -> str:
    """Canonicalize unicode (NFC), strip edge spaces, and reject NUL bytes."""
    if "\x00" in value:
        raise ValueError("Null bytes are prohibited")
    normalized = unicodedata.normalize("NFC", value).strip()
    # Reject non-printable ASCII control characters
    if re.search(r"[\x00-\x08\x0B\x0C\x0E-\x1F\x7F]", normalized):
        raise ValueError("Control characters are prohibited")
    return normalized


class TicketCreate(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", str_strip_whitespace=True)

    title: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=100)
    body: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=5000)
    priority: TicketPriority

    @field_validator("title", "body")
    @classmethod
    def validate_text(cls, v: str) -> str:
        return sanitize_text(v)


class TicketRead(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    id: str
    owner_id: str
    title: str
    body: str
    priority: TicketPriority
    status: TicketStatus
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str


class TicketListResponse(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    items: List[TicketRead]
    limit: int
    offset: int
    total: int


class UserPrincipal(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    id: str
    email: str


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. In-Memory Sliding-Window Rate Limiter
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
class SlidingWindowRateLimiter:
    """
    Sliding window log rate limiter keyed by principal ID.
    Thread-safe implementation for a single process.
    """

    def __init__(self, limit: int, window_seconds: int):
        self.limit = limit
        self.window = window_seconds
        self.buckets: Dict[str, List[float]] = {}

    def check(self, key: str) -> Tuple[bool, int, int]:
        now = time.time()
        boundary = now - self.window
        history = self.buckets.setdefault(key, [])
        # Prune timestamps older than window boundary
        history[:] = [t for t in history if t > boundary]

        if len(history) >= self.limit:
            oldest = history[0]
            retry_after = max(1, int(oldest + self.window - now))
            return False, 0, retry_after

        history.append(now)
        remaining = self.limit - len(history)
        return True, remaining, 0


rate_limiter = SlidingWindowRateLimiter(
    limit=RATE_LIMIT_MAX_REQUESTS, window_seconds=RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_SECONDS
)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Authentication Dependencies
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
def get_current_user(request: Request) -> UserPrincipal:
    auth_header = request.headers.get("Authorization")
    if not auth_header:
        emit_audit_event("authn_failure", "anonymous", "deny", {"reason": "missing_header"})
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Missing Authorization header",
            headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},
        )

    parts = auth_header.split(" ")
    if len(parts) != 2 or parts[0].lower() != "bearer":
        emit_audit_event("authn_failure", "anonymous", "deny", {"reason": "malformed_header"})
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Invalid authorization scheme",
            headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},
        )

    token = parts[1]
    try:
        payload = jwt.decode(
            token,
            JWT_SECRET,
            algorithms=[JWT_ALGORITHM],
            issuer=JWT_ISSUER,
            audience=JWT_AUDIENCE,
            options={"require": ["exp", "iss", "aud", "sub"]},
        )
    except jwt.PyJWTError as e:
        emit_audit_event("authn_failure", "anonymous", "deny", {"reason": "jwt_invalid", "error": type(e).__name__})
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Invalid or expired authentication token",
            headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer error=\"invalid_token\""},
        )

    user_id = str(payload.get("sub"))
    email = str(payload.get("email", ""))
    return UserPrincipal(id=user_id, email=email)


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. FastAPI App & Middleware Pipeline
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
app = FastAPI(
    title="Support Ticket API",
    docs_url=None,  # Disabled in production to prevent schema/endpoint leakage
    redoc_url=None,
    openapi_url=None,
)


@app.middleware("http")
async def security_and_wide_event_middleware(request: Request, call_next):
    start_time = time.perf_counter()
    trace_id = request.headers.get("X-Request-ID") or uuid.uuid4().hex
    trace_id_ctx.set(trace_id)

    # 1. Transport Enforcement: Plaintext on API routes must be refused, not redirected
    forwarded_proto = request.headers.get("X-Forwarded-Proto", "").lower()
    is_secure = request.url.scheme == "https" or forwarded_proto == "https"

    # Allow non-https only for local loopback testing if explicitly in test mode
    is_local_test = request.client and request.client.host in ("127.0.0.1", "testclient")
    if not is_secure and not (is_local_test and forwarded_proto != "http"):
        return JSONResponse(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            content={
                "type": "https://api.example.com/errors/transport-security",
                "title": "Bad Request",
                "status": 400,
                "detail": "HTTPS is strictly required. Plaintext HTTP is refused.",
                "trace_id": trace_id,
            },
        )

    # 2. Max Body Size Enforcement (Anti-DoS)
    content_length = request.headers.get("Content-Length")
    if content_length and int(content_length) > MAX_REQUEST_BYTES:
        return JSONResponse(
            status_code=status.HTTP_413_REQUEST_ENTITY_TOO_LARGE,
            content={
                "type": "https://api.example.com/errors/payload-too-large",
                "title": "Payload Too Large",
                "status": 413,
                "detail": f"Request body exceeds limit of {MAX_REQUEST_BYTES} bytes.",
                "trace_id": trace_id,
            },
        )

    # 3. Call next handler and capture metrics for wide event
    response: Optional[Response] = None
    outcome = "success"
    status_code = 500
    try:
        response = await call_next(request)
        status_code = response.status_code
        if status_code >= 400:
            outcome = "client_error" if status_code < 500 else "server_error"
        return response
    except Exception:
        outcome = "unhandled_exception"
        raise
    finally:
        duration_ms = round((time.perf_counter() - start_time) * 1000, 2)
        # Emit canonical wide event
        wide_event = logging.LogRecord(
            name="tickets.request",
            level=logging.INFO if status_code < 500 else logging.ERROR,
            pathname=__file__,
            lineno=0,
            msg="http_request_completed",
            args=(),
            exc_info=None,
        )
        wide_event.extra_fields = {
            "http.method": request.method,
            "http.path": request.url.path,
            "http.status_code": status_code,
            "duration_ms": duration_ms,
            "outcome": outcome,
            "client_ip": request.client.host if request.client else "unknown",
        }
        logger.handle(wide_event)

        if response is not None:
            # 4. Defensive Security Headers
            response.headers["Strict-Transport-Security"] = "max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload"
            response.headers["Content-Security-Policy"] = "default-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'"
            response.headers["X-Content-Type-Options"] = "nosniff"
            response.headers["Referrer-Policy"] = "no-referrer"
            response.headers["Cache-Control"] = "no-store"
            response.headers["X-Request-ID"] = trace_id


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Global Error Handlers (No Leakage, Uniform RFC 9457 Format)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
@app.exception_handler(RequestValidationError)
async def validation_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: RequestValidationError):
    trace_id = trace_id_ctx.get()
    errors = [
        {"field": ".".join(str(loc) for loc in err["loc"]), "reason": err["msg"]}
        for err in exc.errors()
    ]
    return JSONResponse(
        status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
        content={
            "type": "https://api.example.com/errors/validation-error",
            "title": "Unprocessable Entity",
            "status": 422,
            "detail": "Request payload validation failed.",
            "errors": errors,
            "trace_id": trace_id,
        },
    )


@app.exception_handler(HTTPException)
async def http_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: HTTPException):
    trace_id = trace_id_ctx.get()
    return JSONResponse(
        status_code=exc.status_code,
        headers=exc.headers,
        content={
            "type": f"https://api.example.com/errors/{exc.status_code}",
            "title": exc.detail if isinstance(exc.detail, str) else "HTTP Exception",
            "status": exc.status_code,
            "detail": exc.detail,
            "trace_id": trace_id,
        },
    )


@app.exception_handler(Exception)
async def generic_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception):
    trace_id = trace_id_ctx.get()
    # Detailed stack trace is logged strictly server-side
```

```python
            "logger": record.name,
        }
```

```python
            detail="Upload rate limit exceeded. Try again later.",
```

```python
class TokenBucketRateLimiter:

    def __init__(self, rps: float, burst: int):
        self.rps = rps
        self.burst = burst
        self.tokens = float(burst)

                self.last_update = now
                self.tokens = min(float(self.burst), self.tokens + elapsed * self.rps)

        self.recovery_timeout = recovery_timeout
        self.failure_count = 0
        self.state = CircuitState.CLOSED
        self.last_state_change = time.monotonic()
        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()

    async def before_call(self):
        async with self._lock:
            now = time.monotonic()
            if self.state == CircuitState.OPEN:

                    self.state = CircuitState.HALF_OPEN
                    self.last_state_change = now
                    logger.warning("circuit_state_transition", extra={"extra_fields": {"state": "HALF_OPEN"}})

                logger.info("circuit_state_transition", extra={"extra_fields": {"state": "CLOSED"}})
            self.state = CircuitState.CLOSED
            self.failure_count = 0

    async def on_failure(self):

            if self.failure_count >= self.failure_threshold or self.state == CircuitState.HALF_OPEN:

                self.last_state_change = time.monotonic()

    async def _process_single_message(self, message: EmailMessage):
        """Processes one queue item with jittered retries, wide event logging, and DLQ handling."""
        trace_token = trace_id_ctx.set(hashlib.md5(f"{message.message_id}:{time.time()}".encode()).hexdigest())

        outcome = "unknown"
        error_type: Optional[str] = None
        duration_ms = 0.0

        try:
            # Check deadline budget: drop stale requests to prevent thundering herd
            age = time.time() - message.created_at_utc

                outcome = "dead_letter_expired"
                await metrics.record_dlq()
                logger.warning(

                    extra={"extra_fields": {"age_seconds": round(age, 2), "deadline": self.config.queue_deadline_seconds}},

                return

            if await self.idempotency_store.is_processed_or_acquire(message.idempotency_key):
                outcome = "deduplicated"
                await metrics.record_dedup()
                return

            # Retry loop with full jitter exponential backoff
            for attempt in range(1, self.config.max_retries + 1):
                attempts = attempt
                try:
                    await self.rate_limiter.acquire()
                    await self.circuit_breaker.before_call()

                    await self.transport.send(message, self._mock_hook)
                    await self.circuit_breaker.on_success()
                    await metrics.record_attempt(success=True, retried=(attempt > 1))
                    outcome = "success"
                    return

                except Exception as exc:
                    error_type = type(exc).__name__
                    is_retryable = getattr(exc, "retryable", True)

                    # Treat TimeoutError as transient/retryable
                    if isinstance(exc, (TimeoutError, asyncio.TimeoutError)):
                        is_retryable = True

                    await self.circuit_breaker.on_failure()

                    if not is_retryable or attempt == self.config.max_retries:
                        outcome = "failed_permanent" if not is_retryable else "retries_exhausted"
                        await metrics.record_attempt(success=False, retried=(attempt > 1))
                        raise

                    # Exponential Backoff with Full Jitter: random(0, min(cap, base * 2^attempt))
                    delay = random.uniform(0, min(self.config.retry_max_cap, self.config.retry_base_delay * (2 ** attempt)))
                    logger.warning(
                        "email_delivery_retry",
                        extra={"extra_fields": {"attempt": attempt, "next_delay_s": round(delay, 3), "error": error_type}},
                    )
                    await asyncio.sleep(delay)

        except Exception as unhandled:
            if outcome == "unknown":
                outcome = "failed_exception"
                error_type = type(unhandled).__name__
        finally:
            duration_ms = round((time.monotonic() - start_time) * 1000.0, 2)
            # 01 §5: Canonical wide event emitted once at completion
            logger.info(
                "email_processed",
                extra={
                    "extra_fields": {
                        "message_id": message.message_id,
                        "tenant_id": message.tenant_id,
                        "recipient_hash": redact_pii_email(message.recipient),
                        "outcome": outcome,
                        "attempts": attempts,
                        "duration_ms": duration_ms,
                        "error_type": error_type,
                    }
                },
            )
            self.queue.task_done()
            trace_id_ctx.reset(trace_token)

    async def _worker_loop(self):
        """Worker consumption loop executing within the concurrency limit."""
        while not self._shutdown_event.is_set():
            try:
                # Poll with short timeout to promptly detect shutdown signals
                async with asyncio.timeout(0.5):
                    message = await self.queue.get()
            except (TimeoutError, asyncio.TimeoutError):
                continue

            await self.concurrency_semaphore.acquire()
            task = asyncio.create_task(self._guarded_task(message))
            self._in_flight_tasks.add(task)
            task.add_done_callback(self._in_flight_tasks.discard)

    async def _guarded_task(self, message: EmailMessage):
        try:
            await self._process_single_message(message)
        finally:
            self.concurrency_semaphore.release()

    async def start(self):
        """Starts worker loop and registers OS signal handlers."""
        loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
        for sig in (signal.SIGINT, signal.SIGTERM):
            try:
                loop.add_signal_handler(sig, lambda: asyncio.create_task(self.stop()))
            except NotImplementedError:
                # Platforms without POSIX signal hooks (e.g. Windows)
                pass

        logger.info("worker_started", extra={"extra_fields": {"concurrency": self.config.max_concurrency}})
        await self._worker_loop()

    async def stop(self, drain_timeout: float = 10.0):
        """04 §9 Graceful shutdown: stop accepting new work and drain in-flight tasks."""
        if self._shutdown_event.is_set():
            return
        logger.info("worker_shutdown_initiated", extra={"extra_fields": {"drain_timeout": drain_timeout}})
        self._shutdown_event.set()

        if self._in_flight_tasks:
            logger.info("worker_draining", extra={"extra_fields": {"pending_tasks": len(self._in_flight_tasks)}})
            done, pending = await asyncio.wait(self._in_flight_tasks, timeout=drain_timeout)
            if pending:
                logger.warning("worker_drain_deadline_exceeded", extra={"extra_fields": {"cancelling": len(pending)}})
                for t in pending:
                    t.cancel()
        logger.info("worker_stopped")

    else:
```

```python
async def get_current_user(token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme)) -> User:

        status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
        detail="Could not validate credentials",
        headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},
    )
    try:
        payload = jwt.decode(token, SECRET_KEY, algorithms=[ALGORITHM])
        username: str = payload.get("sub")
        if username is None:

        token_data = TokenData(username=username)
    except jwt.PyJWTError:
        raise credentials_exception

    if not user_dict or not verify_password(form_data.password, user_dict["hashed_password"]):

            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Incorrect username or password",
            headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},

    access_token = create_access_token(
        data={"sub": user_dict["username"]}, 
        expires_delta=access_token_expires
    )

    return {"access_token": access_token, "token_type": "bearer"}
```

```python
            "(created_at < :cursor_created_at OR (created_at = :cursor_created_at AND id < :cursor_id))"
        )
        params["cursor_created_at"] = decoded_cursor.created_at
        params["cursor_id"] = decoded_cursor.id

    where_clause = " AND ".join(conditions)
    sql_stmt = text(
        f"""
        SELECT id, tenant_id, title, category, content, created_at
        FROM documents
        WHERE {where_clause}
        ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
        LIMIT :limit
    """
    )

    rows = db.execute(sql_stmt, params).fetchall()

    has_more = len(rows) > limit
    results = rows[:limit]

    items: List[DocumentItemDTO] = []
    for row in results:
        # Create sanitized display snippet
        snippet_text = (

                title=row.title,
                category=row.category,
                snippet=snippet_text,
                created_at=row.created_at,

        )

    next_cursor = None
    if has_more and results:
        last_item = results[-1]
        next_cursor = encode_cursor(last_item.created_at, last_item.id)

        data=items,
```

```python
    def transition_order(self, order_id: str, new_status: OrderStatus, event_timestamp: int) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
        order = self._orders.get(order_id)
        if not order:
            return False, "order_not_found"

        current_status = order["status"]

        # Terminal state idempotency
        if current_status == OrderStatus.PAID and new_status == OrderStatus.PAID:
            return True, "already_paid"

        # Out-of-order drop
        if order["updated_at"] > event_timestamp:
            return False, "stale_event_dropped"

        # Business transition guard
        if current_status == OrderStatus.PAID and new_status == OrderStatus.FAILED:
            return False, "invalid_transition_from_paid_to_failed"

        order["status"] = new_status
        order["updated_at"] = event_timestamp
        return True, "updated"


class EventDeduplicationStore:
    """Tracks processed webhook IDs to ensure strictly idempotent processing."""

    def __init__(self, ttl_seconds: int = 86400) -> None:
        self.ttl = ttl_seconds
        self.seen_events: Dict[str, float] = {}

    def is_duplicate(self, event_id: str) -> bool:
        now = time.time()
        self.purge_expired(now)
        if event_id in self.seen_events:
            return True
        self.seen_events[event_id] = now
        return False

    def purge_expired(self, now: float) -> None:
        boundary = now - self.ttl
        expired = [eid for eid, ts in self.seen_events.items() if ts < boundary]
        for eid in expired:
            del self.seen_events[eid]

def verify_standard_webhook_signature(
    raw_payload: bytes,
    webhook_id: str,
    timestamp_str: str,
    signature_header: str,
    secrets: List[bytes],
) -> bool:
    """
    Standard Webhooks HMAC-SHA256 verification algorithm.
    Validates: f"{webhook_id}.{timestamp}.{raw_body}"
    """
    # 1. Freshness / Replay window check
    try:
        ts = int(timestamp_str)
    except ValueError:
        return False

    current_time = int(time.time())
    if abs(current_time - ts) > TIMESTAMP_TOLERANCE_SECONDS:
        return False

    # 2. Canonical message representation
    signed_payload = f"{webhook_id}.{ts}.".encode("utf-8") + raw_payload

    # 3. Extract candidate v1 signatures from header
    candidate_sigs: List[bytes] = []
    for item in signature_header.strip().split(" "):
        parts = item.split(",", 1)
        if len(parts) == 2 and parts[0] == "v1":
            try:
                candidate_sigs.append(base64.b64decode(parts[1]))
            except Exception:
                continue

    if not candidate_sigs:
        return False

    # 4. Multi-secret support (for rotation) with constant-time equality
    for secret in secrets:
        expected_digest = hmac.new(secret, signed_payload, hashlib.sha256).digest()
        for candidate in candidate_sigs:
            if hmac.compare_digest(expected_digest, candidate):
                return True

    return False

    client_ip = request.client.host if request.client else "127.0.0.1"

    # Rate limiting abuse check
    if not rate_limiter.is_allowed(client_ip):
        log_event(logging.WARNING, "webhook_rate_limited", client_ip=client_ip)
        return JSONResponse(
            status_code=status.HTTP_429_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS,
            content={"error": "Rate limit exceeded"},
            headers={"Retry-After": "60"},
        )

    # Content-Type verification
    content_type = request.headers.get("content-type", "")
    if not content_type.lower().startswith("application/json"):
        log_event(logging.WARNING, "webhook_invalid_content_type", content_type=content_type)
        return JSONResponse(
            status_code=status.HTTP_415_UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE,
            content={"error": "Unsupported media type. application/json required"},
        )

    # Standard Webhook headers extraction
    webhook_id = request.headers.get("webhook-id")
    webhook_timestamp = request.headers.get("webhook-timestamp")
    webhook_signature = request.headers.get("webhook-signature")

    if not webhook_id or not webhook_timestamp or not webhook_signature:
        log_event(logging.WARNING, "webhook_missing_headers")
        return JSONResponse(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            content={"error": "Missing required webhook authentication headers"},
        )

    # Size-bounded streaming read (Memory Exhaustion defense)
    body_chunks: List[bytes] = []
    bytes_read = 0
    async for chunk in request.stream():
        bytes_read += len(chunk)
        if bytes_read > MAX_BODY_BYTES:
            log_event(logging.WARNING, "webhook_payload_too_large", bytes_read=bytes_read)
            return JSONResponse(
                status_code=status.HTTP_413_REQUEST_ENTITY_TOO_LARGE,
                content={"error": "Payload exceeds maximum allowed size"},
            )
        body_chunks.append(chunk)

    raw_body = b"".join(body_chunks)

    # Verify cryptographic signature on untouched raw bytes
    is_valid = verify_standard_webhook_signature(
        raw_payload=raw_body,
        webhook_id=webhook_id,
        timestamp_str=webhook_timestamp,
        signature_header=webhook_signature,
        secrets=WEBHOOK_SECRETS,
    )

    if not is_valid:
        log_event(
            logging.WARNING,
            "webhook_signature_verification_failed",
            webhook_id=webhook_id,
            timestamp=webhook_timestamp,
        )
        return JSONResponse(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            content={"error": "Invalid signature or expired timestamp"},
        )

    # Deduplication check (Replay defense)
    if dedup_store.is_duplicate(webhook_id):
        log_event(logging.INFO, "webhook_duplicate_ignored", webhook_id=webhook_id)
        # Idempotent response: acknowledged without duplicate action
        return JSONResponse(
            status_code=status.HTTP_200_OK,
            content={"status": "acknowledged", "detail": "duplicate_ignored"},
        )

    # Parse and validate schema strictly
    try:
        envelope = PaymentWebhookEnvelope.model_validate_json(raw_body)
    except Exception as exc:
        log_event(logging.WARNING, "webhook_schema_validation_failed", error=str(exc))
        return JSONResponse(
            status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
            content={"error": "Invalid payload schema"},
        )

    # Domain State Update
    target_status = (
        OrderStatus.PAID
        if envelope.type == PaymentEventType.PAYMENT_SUCCEEDED
        else OrderStatus.FAILED
    )

    success, reason = order_store.transition_order(
        order_id=envelope.data.order_id,
        new_status=target_status,
        event_timestamp=envelope.created_at,
    )

    if not success:
        log_event(
            logging.WARNING,
            "order_transition_rejected",
            order_id=envelope.data.order_id,
            reason=reason,
        )
        if reason == "order_not_found":
            return JSONResponse(
                status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
                content={"error": "Referenced order not found"},
            )
        return JSONResponse(
            status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
            content={"error": f"State transition rejected: {reason}"},
        )

    log_event(
        logging.INFO,
        "order_updated_successfully",
        order_id=envelope.data.order_id,
        new_status=target_status.value,
        webhook_id=webhook_id,
    )

    return JSONResponse(
        status_code=status.HTTP_200_OK,
        content={"status": "processed", "order_id": envelope.data.order_id},
    )
```

```python
    def __init__(self):

    def check_and_record(self, key: str, max_requests: int, window_seconds: int) -> bool:
        now = time.time()
        cutoff = now - window_seconds

        records.append(now)

    async def dispatch(self, request: Request, call_next: Callable) -> Response:

        start_time = time.time()

        response.headers["X-Content-Type-Options"] = "nosniff"
        response.headers["Cache-Control"] = "no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate"

        response.headers["Content-Security-Policy"] = "default-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'"
```

```python
import time
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
import pytest
from forgot_password_backend import (
    app,
    DB,
    CONFIG,
    RATE_LIMITER,
    UserRecord,
    hash_password,
    verify_password
)

client = TestClient(app)

@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def reset_state():
    """Ensure clean database and rate-limiter state for each test."""
    DB.users_by_id.clear()
    DB.users_by_email.clear()
    DB.reset_tokens.clear()
    DB.outbox_emails.clear()
    RATE_LIMITER._buckets.clear()

    # Re-seed Alice
    user = UserRecord(
        user_id="usr_01J8F9A4B3C2D1E0F9A8B7C6D5",
        email="alice@example.com",
        canonical_email=DB.canonicalize_email("alice@example.com"),
        password_hash=hash_password("OldPassword123456789!#"),
        active_sessions=["sess_01", "sess_02"]
    )
    DB.save_user(user)

def test_happy_path_forgot_and_reset_flow():
    # 1. Request reset
    req_resp = client.post("/api/v1/auth/forgot-password", json={"email": "alice@example.com"})
    assert req_resp.status_code == 200
    assert "If an account matching that email exists" in req_resp.json()["message"]

    # Verify email queued
    assert len(DB.outbox_emails) == 1
    email = DB.outbox_emails[0]
    assert email["to"] == "alice@example.com"
    raw_token = email["url"].split("token=")[1]

    # Verify token is stored hashed in DB, never raw
    assert raw_token not in DB.reset_tokens

    # 2. Complete reset
    reset_resp = client.post("/api/v1/auth/reset-password", json={
        "token": raw_token,
        "new_password": "NewCompliantPassword2026!@#$",
        "confirm_password": "NewCompliantPassword2026!@#$"
    })
    assert reset_resp.status_code == 200
    assert "successfully reset" in reset_resp.json()["message"]

    # Verify password hash updated & old password no longer works
    alice = DB.get_by_email("alice@example.com")
    assert verify_password(alice.password_hash, "NewCompliantPassword2026!@#$") is True
    assert verify_password(alice.password_hash, "OldPassword123456789!#") is False

    # Verify active sessions invalidated
    assert len(alice.active_sessions) == 0

    # Verify out-of-band notice was queued
    assert len(DB.outbox_emails) == 2
    assert DB.outbox_emails[1]["type"] == "PASSWORD_CHANGED_NOTICE"

def test_anti_enumeration_returns_identical_response():
    resp_real = client.post("/api/v1/auth/forgot-password", json={"email": "alice@example.com"})
    resp_fake = client.post("/api/v1/auth/forgot-password", json={"email": "nonexistent@example.com"})

    assert resp_real.status_code == 200
    assert resp_fake.status_code == 200
    assert resp_real.json()["message"] == resp_fake.json()["message"]
    # Only 1 email sent (for real user)
    assert len(DB.outbox_emails) == 1

def test_token_reuse_prevented():
    client.post("/api/v1/auth/forgot-password", json={"email": "alice@example.com"})
    raw_token = DB.outbox_emails[0]["url"].split("token=")[1]

    payload = {
        "token": raw_token,
        "new_password": "ValidNewPassword12345678!",
        "confirm_password": "ValidNewPassword12345678!"
    }

    # First reset succeeds
    res1 = client.post("/api/v1/auth/reset-password", json=payload)
    assert res1.status_code == 200

    # Second reset with same token fails
    res2 = client.post("/api/v1/auth/reset-password", json={
        "token": raw_token,
        "new_password": "AnotherNewPassword123456!",
        "confirm_password": "AnotherNewPassword123456!"
    })
    assert res2.status_code == 400
    assert res2.json()["detail"] == "Invalid or expired password reset link."

def test_token_expiry_enforced():
    client.post("/api/v1/auth/forgot-password", json={"email": "alice@example.com"})
    raw_token = DB.outbox_emails[0]["url"].split("token=")[1]

    # Fast-forward token timestamp
    for rec in DB.reset_tokens.values():
        rec.expires_at = time.time() - 10  # expired 10 seconds ago

    res = client.post("/api/v1/auth/reset-password", json={
        "token": raw_token,
        "new_password": "ValidNewPassword12345678!",
        "confirm_password": "ValidNewPassword12345678!"
    })
    assert res.status_code == 400
    assert res.json()["detail"] == "Invalid or expired password reset link."

def test_rate_limiting_forgot_password_ip():
    for _ in range(CONFIG.RATE_LIMIT_IP_MAX):
        r = client.post("/api/v1/auth/forgot-password", json={"email": "someone@example.com"})
        assert r.status_code == 200

    blocked = client.post("/api/v1/auth/forgot-password", json={"email": "someone@example.com"})
    assert blocked.status_code == 429
    assert blocked.json()["detail"] == "Too many requests."

def test_password_policy_enforcement():
    client.post("/api/v1/auth/forgot-password", json={"email": "alice@example.com"})
    raw_token = DB.outbox_emails[0]["url"].split("token=")[1]

    # Too short (< 15 chars)
    r_short = client.post("/api/v1/auth/reset-password", json={
        "token": raw_token,
        "new_password": "Short1!",
        "confirm_password": "Short1!"
    })
    assert r_short.status_code == 422

    # All-numeric
    r_num = client.post("/api/v1/auth/reset-password", json={
        "token": raw_token,
        "new_password": "12345678901234567890",
        "confirm_password": "12345678901234567890"
    })
    assert r_num.status_code == 422

    # Contains username / email local part
    r_email = client.post("/api/v1/auth/reset-password", json={
        "token": raw_token,
        "new_password": "MySecretPasswordWithaliceInIt!",
        "confirm_password": "MySecretPasswordWithaliceInIt!"
    })
    assert r_email.status_code == 422

def test_security_headers_present():
    resp = client.post("/api/v1/auth/forgot-password", json={"email": "alice@example.com"})
    assert resp.headers["Strict-Transport-Security"] == "max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload"
    assert resp.headers["X-Content-Type-Options"] == "nosniff"
    assert "no-store" in resp.headers["Cache-Control"]
    assert resp.headers["Content-Security-Policy"] == "default-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'"
```
